title: Technique library: neural shader for clouds, three js
author: Brave-History-6502
selftext:
I saw someone post an article about this as part of their project and pulled out the rendering technique, and translated it to threejs for a reference for my agents: [https://gamecrew.ai/techniques/three/neural-volumetric-clouds](https://gamecrew.ai/techniques/three/neural-volumetric-clouds)

this rendering technique works well when you need cloud scenes that evolve with lighting.

context: I’m working on building a free technique library where folks can easy pull (and push) various techniques or approaches across the spectrum of game systems.  

 long term I believe strongly that future game dev is going to be much less centralized and more like open source development.

  
feel free to use this, or connect to the  mcp and pull it
